findings.note: staging_dir (src/baseline.rs ~369) is private and clock-named, so the 16-attempt retry is untested; a test gap, not a behaviour defect.
verify returns 'could not stage inputs' before remove_dir_all (src/baseline.rs ~396-399), and the per-call unique name means each failure orphans a new directory.
tests/baseline.rs the_staging_dir_is_owner_only uses std::os::unix::fs::PermissionsExt with no #[cfg(unix)], while create_staging_dir gates mode under cfg(unix).
The exclusive-creation test only re-creates a real directory; the symlink case the doc comment asserts is untested, but DirBuilder::create already fails on any existing path.
Overstated: remove_dir_all does run after minisign on success and on minisign failure, but the error path it also names (staging write failure) does leak a fresh directory, which is G1.
Same as F03: an ungated unix-only import in tests/baseline.rs breaks compilation of the test crate on non-unix targets.
